Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
Q: Is there a general set of principles that determine which cards can
be repeated for cumulative effect and which cannot?

Individual Questions:

Q: Can a vampire play 3 atonements to gain +3 intercept?

Q: If 3 different vampires play Elder Kindred Network in reaction to
a called vote, and the vote ties, does the acting methuselah lose
1 pool, or 3?

Q: If 3 Judgement: Camarilla Segregations are called into play, do
methuselahs controlling Non-Camarilla vampires burn 3 pool each
turn?

Q: Do 3 Nosferatu Putrescences reduce a nosferatu's hand damage by 3?

Q: If a nosferaue plays 3 Patagia's does he gain 3 optional maneuvers
per combat for the rest of the game?

Q: If 3 Masquerade Enforcements are in play must Methuselahs burn
3 pool to bring out vampires?

Q: Does your prey lose 3 pool each turn from 3 Army of Rats?

Q: What happens when you pass 1st Tradition: Masquerade TWICE in one
round, and then once again the round after???

Q: Can you play 3 Aching Beauties on the same vampire so that a
blocking methuselah could lose 3 pool?

Q: Do 3 Anarch Revolts cause methuselahs to burn 3 pool per turn?

Q: Can you play 3 Bestial Visages on a Gangrel Antitribu to give
-3 stealth on actions?

Q: Are multiple Blood Dolls on a single vampire cumulative?

Q: If Carthage Remembered is put in play 3 times, do Brujah Princes
and Justicars gain +3 stealth on bleed actions?

Q: If you put 3 Children of Osiris in play, do Settites burn
3 blood to untap?

Q: If 3 Cultivated Blood Shortages are in play, do Ventrue lose
3 blood each turn?

Q: If 3 Fear of Mekhet's are played on a Justicar in a single turn,
must he burn 15 blood on his next untap phase?

Q: Do 3 Gangrel De-evolutions reduce a gangrel's bleed by 3?

Q: Do 3 Guardian Angels give you +3 intercept against bleeds, and
prevent up to 3 damage each combat?

Q: Do 3 Tremere Convocations gain a vampire +3 Stealth on actions
requiring Thaumaturgy?

Q: Do 3 Ventrue Directorate Assemblies give each ready Ventrue an
Additional 3 Votes?

Q: Do 3 Mass Realities in play at Superior cause your weapons to
inflict +6 damage?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
jbwh...@dorsai.org (John Whelan) writes:
>Q: Is there a general set of principles that determine which cards can
> be repeated for cumulative effect and which cannot?

Yes. Effects are cumulative. Ability-granting effects will only redundantly
grant an ability, not make the ability more powerful.

>Individual Questions:

>Q: Can a vampire play 3 atonements to gain +3 intercept?

Yes.

>Q: If 3 different vampires play Elder Kindred Network in reaction to
> a called vote, and the vote ties, does the acting methuselah lose
> 1 pool, or 3?

Three.

>Q: If 3 Judgement: Camarilla Segregations are called into play, do
> methuselahs controlling Non-Camarilla vampires burn 3 pool each
> turn?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Nosferatu Putrescences reduce a nosferatu's hand damage by 3?

Yes.

>Q: If a nosferaue plays 3 Patagia's does he gain 3 optional maneuvers
> per combat for the rest of the game?

Yes.

>Q: If 3 Masquerade Enforcements are in play must Methuselahs burn
> 3 pool to bring out vampires?

Yes.

>Q: Does your prey lose 3 pool each turn from 3 Army of Rats?

No. Card text (errata to the Jyhad version) limits the loss to 1.

>Q: What happens when you pass 1st Tradition: Masquerade TWICE in one
> round, and then once again the round after???

Each one counts the number of times you pass your turn or pay a penalty.
Passing your turn will increment the count for every 1stTrad in play, while
taking your turn will cost you two pool for every 1stTrad in play (and
increment the count...)

>Q: Can you play 3 Aching Beauties on the same vampire so that a
> blocking methuselah could lose 3 pool?

Yes.

>
>Q: Do 3 Anarch Revolts cause methuselahs to burn 3 pool per turn?

Yes.

>Q: Can you play 3 Bestial Visages on a Gangrel Antitribu to give
> -3 stealth on actions?

Yes.

>Q: Are multiple Blood Dolls on a single vampire cumulative?

Yes.

>Q: If Carthage Remembered is put in play 3 times, do Brujah Princes
> and Justicars gain +3 stealth on bleed actions?

Yes.

>Q: If you put 3 Children of Osiris in play, do Settites burn
> 3 blood to untap?

No. They all don't untap (this effect is produced three times) as normal
during the untap phase. They are all granted the ability to pay one blood
to untap (this ability is granted three times) during the untap phase.

>Q: If 3 Cultivated Blood Shortages are in play, do Ventrue lose
> 3 blood each turn?

Yes.

>Q: If 3 Fear of Mekhet's are played on a Justicar in a single turn,
> must he burn 15 blood on his next untap phase?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Gangrel De-evolutions reduce a gangrel's bleed by 3?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Guardian Angels give you +3 intercept against bleeds, and
> prevent up to 3 damage each combat?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Tremere Convocations gain a vampire +3 Stealth on actions
> requiring Thaumaturgy?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Ventrue Directorate Assemblies give each ready Ventrue an
> Additional 3 Votes?

Yes.

>Q: Do 3 Mass Realities in play at Superior cause your weapons to
> inflict +6 damage?

Yes.

Messages.Body:
>>Q: If a nosferaue plays 3 Patagia's does he gain 3 optional maneuvers

No, The V:Tes version declares that: "A vampire may have only one Patagia card."

Sorry - you are correct.

multiple maneuvers if some new Sabbat vampire has text that says he
ignores restrictions on playing multiple cards :-)
